description: A questionnaire question with its answer options (tables QUESTION and QUESTION_OPTION). Reference data.

schema_version.description: Version of the document shape, 1 for schema v1 (allows document-by-document migration later).

field_key.description: Key used by the questionnaire encoder: lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter, 2-40 characters (unique).

text.description: Question shown in the app (English, SCIN wording), at most 255 characters.

answer_type.description: Answer type: single, multi or ordinal.

option_value.description: Option code, 1-60 letters, digits or _ (SCIN codes kept as in the dataset).

label.description: Text shown for the option, at most 120 characters.

position.description: Position inside the question, 1-99 (rank for ordinal questions).

is_red_flag.description: true = the app shows the see-a-doctor message whatever the model says.

options.description: Answer options of this question, ordered by position; at most 99 (position 1-99).
